title: Making a case for capacity building
description: In recent years, terms such as systems, leadership, theory of change, and organisational development have become common in the development sector. As grassroots organisations grapple with these concepts and their importance, many still struggle to find funding for their work. Bidyut Mohanty of SPREAD, Odisha, explains it this way. “Funding today is more competitive, results oriented, project driven, and compliance heavy than ever before.
